super_nodes.label: ML potentials, DFT codes, and descriptors
super_nodes.gloss: A mix of molecular ML potential models (ANI, GemNet, DimeNet), DFT/MD simulation codes (VASP, LAMMPS), molecular descriptors, and generic sequence models.

super_nodes.label: Equivariant graph neural network architectures
super_nodes.gloss: Members are almost all graph neural network variants, especially equivariant/message-passing architectures for molecules and crystals, though Pauling File appears as an outlier.

super_nodes.label: MD-17 benchmark datasets for ML potentials
super_nodes.gloss: Mostly MD-17 molecular dynamics benchmark datasets used to test ML potentials like SchNet and NequIP, plus a few DFT k-point sampling methods.

super_nodes.label: Materials Project database and property screening
super_nodes.gloss: A broad mix centered on the Materials Project database and high-throughput screening, plus separate threads on superconductivity formulas and ML melting-temperature prediction.

super_nodes.label: Optimizers and force-based potential training
super_nodes.gloss: A mix of optimization algorithms (Adam, conjugate gradients), JARVIS force-field data, and training methodology for force-based ML interatomic potentials like SchNet.

super_nodes.label: Neural network potentials and CGCNN accuracy
super_nodes.gloss: Behler-Parrinello-style and Deep Potential neural network interatomic potentials, classical empirical potentials (Tersoff, Brenner), plus claims about CGCNN's formation-energy prediction accuracy.

super_nodes.label: Automated ML pipelines and workflow tools
super_nodes.gloss: A mix of Automatminer's AutoML pipeline, STM-image analysis pipelines, DFT workflow validation tools, and scattered technique/component nodes with no single tight theme.

super_nodes.label: DFT+U corrections and relaxation automation
super_nodes.gloss: A mix of DFT+U exchange-correlation correction schemes (LDA+U, GGA+U, Dudarev), neural-network activation functions (GELU, softplus, GRU), and AFLOW/M3GNet relaxation automation.

super_nodes.label: ML potential descriptors and basis expansions
super_nodes.gloss: Building-block components and techniques for ML interatomic potentials: radial/angular/many-body descriptors, spherical harmonics, and kernel methods like GAP, ACE, and SNAP.

super_nodes.label: Coulomb matrix features and DFT convergence
super_nodes.gloss: A diverse mix: Coulomb-matrix molecular featurizers, AFLOW DFT convergence/k-point conventions, convex-hull stability screening, and a formate-on-copper surface study, no single topic.

super_nodes.label: JARVIS infrastructure and phonon prediction
super_nodes.gloss: Mostly the JARVIS materials-informatics infrastructure (DFT, FF, ML, Tools, REST-API), plus a smaller thread on phonon/electronic-structure prediction via M3GNet and AFLOW.

super_nodes.label: DeepH Hamiltonian prediction and extended ACE
super_nodes.gloss: Mostly DeepH's deep-learning prediction of DFT Hamiltonians for graphene, MoS2, and twisted bilayer systems, plus a separate thread generalizing the atomic cluster expansion (ACE).

super_nodes.label: ML molecular potentials and DFT/MD codes
super_nodes.gloss: A mix of ML potentials for molecules (ANI, FCHL, sGDML), molecular descriptors (ECFP4, BAML), and DFT/MD simulation codes (VASP, LAMMPS, CP2K, AFLOW).

super_nodes.label: Neural network architectures for molecular properties
super_nodes.gloss: Mostly equivariant/graph neural network models for molecules and crystals (GemNet, DimeNet, PaiNN, MEGNet, CGCNN), plus some generic architectures like ResNet and WaveNet.

super_nodes.label: E(3)-equivariant neural network architectures
super_nodes.gloss: E(3)/SE(3)-equivariant graph neural network architectures, including tensor field networks, steerable CNNs, and continuous-filter convolutions used in DeepH-E3.

super_nodes.label: MD-17 benchmark datasets for ML potentials
super_nodes.gloss: Mostly MD-17 molecular dynamics benchmark datasets used to test ML potentials like SchNet and NequIP, plus a few DFT k-point sampling methods.

super_nodes.label: Graph neural networks for materials
super_nodes.gloss: Graph neural network architectures for molecules and crystals, from early graph convolutions (Kipf & Welling, Duvenaud) to crystal-specific models like CGCNN and MPNN.

super_nodes.label: High-throughput materials databases and workflows
super_nodes.gloss: High-throughput DFT materials databases and their automated workflows: Materials Project, AFLOW/AFLOWLIB, OQMD, JARVIS, and the Matbench benchmark suite.

super_nodes.label: DFT correction methods and cited authors
super_nodes.gloss: A diverse mix of DFT numerical correction schemes (PAW, Harris-Foulkes, Blochl, Grimme-D2) and various named author citations for unspecified statistical/ML methods, no tight theme.

super_nodes.label: Optimization algorithms for structure design
super_nodes.gloss: Optimization algorithms, gradient-based (Adam, AdamW) and evolutionary (genetic algorithms, TPOT), applied to inverse design and geometry optimization of low-stress structures.

super_nodes.label: Message-passing neural network architecture components
super_nodes.gloss: The building blocks of message-passing neural networks: edge/vertex update blocks, message functions, and specific MPNN variants like directional and local-coordinate message passing.

super_nodes.label: Behler-Parrinello and Deep Potential NN potentials
super_nodes.gloss: Neural network interatomic potentials, mainly Behler-Parrinello-style and Deep Potential/DeepMD variants, plus classical empirical potentials (Tersoff, Brenner) and NASICON training convergence claims.

super_nodes.label: Automatminer AutoML pipeline for materials
super_nodes.gloss: The Automatminer automated machine-learning pipeline for materials property prediction: its featurizers, presets (Express, Debug, Heavy), and Set2Set readout component.

super_nodes.label: DFT+U exchange-correlation methods and AFLOW automation
super_nodes.gloss: DFT+U exchange-correlation correction schemes (LDA+U, GGA+U, Dudarev, Liechtenstein) and the AFLOW standard's automated high-throughput DFT+U calculation protocol.

super_nodes.label: Normalization techniques for ML potential kernels
super_nodes.gloss: A mix of normalization techniques (batch, layer, kernel), neighbor-list/scaling methods for ML potentials, and kernel-based approaches like SNAP and power-spectrum kernels.

super_nodes.label: Coulomb matrix features and CUR decomposition
super_nodes.gloss: Coulomb/Sine-Coulomb matrix molecular representations and CUR matrix decomposition/sparsification techniques, alongside a formate-on-copper surface study and PyTorch tooling.

super_nodes.label: Phonon and electronic band structure prediction
super_nodes.gloss: Phonon spectra and electronic band-structure calculation and prediction, via methods like frozen-phonon and linear-response phonon theory, and models like M3GNet and AFLOW.

super_nodes.label: Benchmark accuracy claims for ML potentials
super_nodes.gloss: Mostly quantitative benchmark-accuracy claims (MAE, RMSE) for ML property-prediction models like CGCNN, SchNet, MPNN, NequIP, GAP, DeePMD, and MEGNet on QM9/MD-17/Matbench.

super_nodes.label: Convex hull stability and volume prediction
super_nodes.gloss: Convex-hull phase-stability analysis and construction, plus unit-cell volume prediction, used to filter and screen candidate crystal structures.

super_nodes.label: Extended ACE for magnetic tensor properties
super_nodes.gloss: The generalized atomic cluster expansion (ACE) extended to magnetic, charge, and tensorial atomic properties, plus related tensor-product and local-coordinate equivariant components.

super_nodes.label: Molecular dynamics simulation tools and training
super_nodes.gloss: Molecular dynamics simulation infrastructure (ASE, VASP, atomate) and protocols for training ML interatomic potentials like NequIP and GAP from MD trajectories.

super_nodes.label: Atomic cluster expansion method details
super_nodes.gloss: The Atomic Cluster Expansion (ACE) method and its implementation details: hierarchical body-order expansion, bond-distance terms, and a multiple-tower speedup architecture.

super_nodes.label: Solid-state electrolyte and battery screening
super_nodes.gloss: High-throughput screening and ML-potential simulation of solid-state electrolytes and battery materials: ionic conductivity, diffusion, anode candidates, and cathode HF-scavenging coatings.

super_nodes.label: Gaussian basis descriptors and GAP potentials
super_nodes.gloss: Gaussian/spherical-harmonic basis-expansion descriptor components and Gaussian Approximation Potentials (GAP), including uncertainty estimation and extrapolation problems for ML potentials.

super_nodes.label: Benchmark datasets: OC20, OQMD, QM9
super_nodes.gloss: Materials/molecular ML benchmark datasets, dominated by the Open Catalyst (OC20/OC22) sets, OQMD, QM9, and solid-electrolyte structures, plus a few DFT codes.

super_nodes.label: Crystal graph representation and interstitial sites
super_nodes.gloss: Crystal-graph representations of atomic structures and AFLOW's topological search for interstitial sites and cages in crystal lattices.

super_nodes.label: Force/stress training methodology for potentials
super_nodes.gloss: Training methodology for force- and stress-aware ML interatomic potentials (energy conservation, loss weighting), plus JARVIS force-field data and classical force fields like AMBER.

super_nodes.label: Matbench/Matminer benchmarking tools and HSE06
super_nodes.gloss: Mostly the Matbench benchmark suite and Matminer data-mining/featurization tools, plus a separate thread on HSE06 hybrid-functional band-gap calculations for ZnO.

super_nodes.label: Tree-ensemble ML for STM image analysis
super_nodes.gloss: Tree-ensemble machine learning methods (Random Forest, gradient boosting, LightGBM) applied to classifying and analyzing scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) images.

super_nodes.label: DFT methods and hybrid functionals
super_nodes.gloss: Core density functional theory methods and exchange-correlation functional variants, including Kohn-Sham DFT, local density approximation, and hybrid functionals like HSE06.

super_nodes.label: MAE/RMSE error metrics for ML models
super_nodes.gloss: Almost entirely MAE and RMSE error metrics (energy, force, formation-energy) used to evaluate ML models, plus the unrelated McMillan/Allen-Dynes superconductivity formulas.

super_nodes.label: Elastic modulus prediction and calculation
super_nodes.gloss: Elastic-property prediction tasks (bulk, shear, Young's modulus) and calculation techniques like Voigt-Reuss-Hill averaging and finite-difference elastic tensor extraction.

super_nodes.label: GAP potential accuracy validated against DFT
super_nodes.gloss: Mostly claims validating the Gaussian Approximation Potential (GAP) for silicon against DFT across many properties, plus scattered claims on formation energy and superconductor screening.

super_nodes.label: Automated workflow and model selection issues
super_nodes.gloss: Problems and infrastructure around automating high-throughput DFT workflows (AFLOW, FireWorks) and materials ML model/pipeline selection, like bias and reproducibility.

super_nodes.label: Formation energy prediction across ML methods
super_nodes.gloss: Formation-energy and activation-energy prediction accuracy across methods: graph networks (CGCNN, MEGNet), Automatminer, and a heuristic-plus-ML model for ternary compounds.

super_nodes.label: ConvLSTM fracture and hardness prediction
super_nodes.gloss: A ConvLSTM-based model predicting dynamic brittle fracture patterns, crack paths, fracture toughness, and Vickers hardness from crystal orientation data.

super_nodes.label: DeepH Hamiltonian prediction for 2D materials
super_nodes.gloss: Mostly DeepH/DeepH-E3's deep-learning prediction of DFT Hamiltonians for graphene, MoS2, and twisted bilayer systems, plus GNN stress prediction in graphene.

super_nodes.label: Materials property prediction and Matbench
super_nodes.gloss: Materials property-prediction tasks and problems, from Matbench benchmarking to crystal structural relaxation, property screening, and challenges like polymorph differentiation.

super_nodes.label: JARVIS integrated materials design infrastructure
super_nodes.gloss: The JARVIS integrated materials-design infrastructure: its DFT, force-field, ML, and Tools components, REST-API, and heterostructure/Wannier tight-binding apps.

super_nodes.label: Neural network layers and interpretability
super_nodes.gloss: Building-block neural network layers (embedding, pooling, equivariant convolution) for materials models like EquiformerV2, plus interpretability of learned chemical trends.

super_nodes.label: Melting temperature prediction via ML
super_nodes.gloss: Machine-learning prediction of melting temperature for binary/inorganic compounds using clustering plus symbolic regression, with elastic moduli as key features.

super_nodes.label: Cross-validation methods and evaluation metrics
super_nodes.gloss: Cross-validation methodology (k-fold, nested, stratified, leave-one-cluster-out) and evaluation metrics (MAE, ROC-AUC) for assessing ML model generalization.

super_nodes.label: M3GNet pre-relaxation and softplus activation
super_nodes.gloss: M3GNet's learned-potential pre-relaxation pipeline for speeding up DFT structural relaxation, built around shifted-softplus activation functions.

super_nodes.label: K-point sampling and DFT convergence
super_nodes.gloss: DFT k-point sampling and convergence techniques, mainly Monkhorst-Pack and NKPPRA-based grids, with some unrelated Voronoi tessellation and spatial-data problems mixed in.

super_nodes.label: Cutoff functions and convex hull screening
super_nodes.gloss: Cutoff-function parameters (plane-wave energy cutoff, smooth radial cutoff) used in DFT and ML potentials, plus convex-hull screening for stiffness-tensor calculations.

super_nodes.label: Active learning for ML potential training
super_nodes.gloss: Iterative active-learning workflows for building training sets for ML interatomic potentials: data cleaning, phase-space sampling, and self-consistent retraining cycles.

super_nodes.label: CGAT network series and datasets
super_nodes.gloss: The CGAT/DCGAT graph-network series and its training and test datasets (CSP Blind Test, Togo Database, G2 molecules), focused on generalization accuracy.

super_nodes.label: Two-body and three-body SOAP descriptors
super_nodes.gloss: Body-order structural descriptors (two-body, three-body, many-body) for ML potentials, especially SOAP and CFID descriptor variants used as model inputs.

super_nodes.label: Uncertainty quantification and error handling
super_nodes.gloss: Uncertainty quantification (Bayesian, GP variance, Monte-Carlo dropout) and error handling/self-healing techniques for ML predictions and automated calculation failures.

super_nodes.label: Global state conditioning and sp-chains
super_nodes.gloss: Global-state/context vector conditioning for modeling state-dependent properties, plus a specific problem of over-predicting linear sp-bonded atomic chains.

super_nodes.label: Surface slab generation and surface energy
super_nodes.gloss: Building and evaluating surface slabs (catalysis, corrosion, reconstruction), including surface-energy prediction and generalization to unseen crystal orientations and bicrystal interfaces.

super_nodes.label: DFT charge mixing and PAW method
super_nodes.gloss: Mostly Pulay charge-mixing for DFT self-consistency and the projector-augmented wave (PAW) method, plus an unrelated 'Phase-Field Hub' entry.
